features.title: Bounded subprocess primitive with output limits and owned-tree cleanup
features.acceptance: F001 spec: validated budgets, explicit argv, status/streams, typed timeout/output errors, bounded tree cleanup and native adversarial unit controls.

features.title: Bound startup Git SHA snapshot without losing startup identity
features.acceptance: F002 spec: bounded capped startup Git, valid SHA or null, import-time immutable snapshot, real stalled executable controls with synthetic homes.

features.title: Integrate bounded Git and Windows reparse supervision into replay
features.acceptance: F003 spec: shared replay deadline, bounded subprocess output, fail-closed timeout/supervision errors, unchanged exact-version queue and confirmation semantics.

features.title: Retain failure reproductions and run portable regression controls
features.acceptance: F004 spec: baseline reproductions, new native process fixtures, preserved original tests/evidence, Node22 fresh install/lint/verify/build/focused/full results with failures and platform skips.

features.title: Independent cross-family exact-candidate acceptance
features.acceptance: F005 spec: independent Kimi-family real process/deadline probes, immutable verdict and scoped signoff, explicit native/production and timing limits; no release inference.
